calls.title: GB x Masterclass - Pricing Discussion
calls.summary: The discussion centered on Masterclass’s use of the experimentation platform, showcasing significant ROI with LTV uplifts between 2.8% and 8.65%, potentially adding $2.8 million in annual revenue. However, Masterclass currently limits itself to basic experimentation, primarily A/B testing, without utilizing Growthbook's advanced features, indicating room for growth. Concerns were raised regarding a proposed pricing increase of three to four times current spend, necessitating internal approval. Technical challenges, such as inconsistencies in SDKs affecting reliable bucket assignments and issues with cross-device tracking due to privacy concerns, were also highlighted. Both parties agreed on enhanced collaboration, with Growthbook promising greater support and feature prioritization tailored to Masterclass's needs, and proposed follow-up discussions to solidify the partnership.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Pricing, Sticky Bucketing, Feature Flagging, ROI, Build vs Buy
